# IPTV (iptv.usama.dev)

> Modern IPTV Live Television Progressive Web App.

## Overview
IPTV allows users to stream live television channels, sports matches, breaking news, music streams, and movies from legal, open IPTV streams and custom M3U/M3U8 playlists.

## Website
- **URL**: https://iptv.usama.dev
- **Sitemap**: https://iptv.usama.dev/sitemap.xml
- **Robots.txt**: https://iptv.usama.dev/robots.txt

## Key Capabilities
1. **Live Stream Playback**: Play HLS `.m3u8` video streams across modern browsers.
2. **Dynamic Channel Routing**: Every channel is accessible directly at `https://iptv.usama.dev/watch/{channel-name}` (e.g. `/watch/nasa-tv-hd`, `/watch/red-bull-tv`).
3. **M3U Playlist Parser**: Users can import any M3U URL or upload local playlist files.
4. **Structured Data**: Implements `BroadcastEvent`, `VideoObject`, and `TelevisionChannel` JSON-LD schemas.
5. **PWA Support**: Full mobile and desktop installation with standalone app mode.

## Categories Available
- News (Bloomberg TV, Al Jazeera, DW English, France 24, Euronews)
- Sports & Action (Red Bull TV, World Poker Tour, Origin Sports)
- Movies & Cinema (Rakuten Action Movies, Comedy, Drama)
- Music & Club (Clubbing TV, Stingray CMusic)
- Documentary & Science (NASA TV HD, WildEarth TV, Weather Spy)
- Kids & Family (Duck TV)
